title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is currently caught in a tug-of-war between ambitious hiring and the weight of legacy practices. Meanwhile, innovation continues to bubble up, albeit with some hiccups in execution.

themes.title: Hiring vs. Heritage Dilemma
themes.body: As the space sector eyes expansion, the challenge remains how to integrate fresh talent with established norms. This tension could stifle innovation if not navigated carefully.

themes.title: Nuclear Batteries in Orbit
themes.body: A startup's foray into nuclear battery technology could redefine energy solutions for long-duration missions. However, the regulatory and safety hurdles remain formidable.

themes.title: Budget Boost for Resilience
themes.body: The recent $1.4 billion addition to the space resilience budget signals a growing recognition of the need for robust defense capabilities in orbit. This could spur further investment in technologies that enhance security.

themes.title: Commercial Reentry Progress
themes.body: ElevationSpace's advancements in commercial reentry vehicles highlight the industry's pivot towards practical applications of space technology. Yet, the path to market remains fraught with technical and regulatory challenges.
